title: Comfortable survival
description: Everything you need to make your survival experience comfortable (Textures, Shaders and mods)
body:
This modpack is a more "comfortable" version of original Minecraft. It focuses on improving your quality of life, adding beautiful visual enhancements, and optimizing performance to keep your gameplay smooth.

❓ Why should you download this modpack?
- True Vanilla Plus Experience: It keeps the core gameplay of Minecraft identical but makes the entire journey much more polished and modern.
- Enhanced Visuals Without Lag: Enjoy fluid entity animations, connected textures, and pre-loaded premium shaders while keeping stable frames per second (FPS).
- Stress-Free Exploration: With fully functional maps, a radar, fullbright adjustments, and zoom mechanics, you will never get lost or frustrated in caves.
- Smart Inventory Management: Advanced shortcuts and automated crafting recipe registries make managing your items seamless and quick.

🛠️ Quality of Life and Utility Mods
These tools make your navigation, inventory management, and exploration much more intuitive:
- AppleSkin: Shows food saturation values and exactly how much health or hunger you will restore.
- Jade: Displays helpful tooltip descriptions at the top of your screen for whatever you look at.
- Gamma Utils: Provides fullbright and custom gamma adjustments for better visibility in caves or dark places.
- Punchy!: Adds smooth, immersive first-person animations and makes your hands visible while holding items.
- Mouse Tweaks: Enhances inventory handling with better mouse dragging and clicking shortcuts.
- Xaero's Minimap and Worldmap: Includes a fully functional on-screen mini-map, radar, and a detailed full-screen map to track your explored world.
- Zoomify: Adds a highly customizable zoom feature to get a closer look at your surroundings.
- Freecam: Allows you to detach your camera from your player character to explore your immediate area freely.

✨ Visual Enhancements and Performance Mods
- Continuity: Enables connected textures support for clean, borderless blocks.
- Voxy: Adds efficient rendering systems for an enhanced voxel landscape experience.
- Chunky: Pre-generates world chunks ahead of time to drastically reduce lag during exploration.
- Optimization Mods: Includes advanced performance mods tuned to ensure stable frames per second (FPS) and fluid gameplay.

🎨 Resource Packs Included
- Fresh Animations and Player Extension (Adds dynamic movements to mobs and players)
- Fresh Animations texture for Xaero's (Fixes the entity radar icons to work properly with Fresh Animations)
- Enchantment Outlines (Adds clean lines to easily identify enchanted items)
- Visual Armor Trims (Showcases your armor customizations clearly)
- Clean Connected Glass (Removes annoying borders from glass blocks)
- MandalasGUI (Features a sleek, comfortable dark-themed interface)
- NewGlowingOres (Makes mineral ores stand out and glow in the dark)

⚠️ Note: When you try to install these texture packs, Minecraft might display a warning saying they are incompatible with your current version. Please ignore this; they are actually fully compatible and work perfectly!

🌌 Included Shaders
The pack comes pre-loaded with four amazing shader options to fit your personal style:
- Solas Shaders
- Photon Shaders
- Complementary Shaders (Reimagined)
- Complementary Shaders (Unbound)

🤝 Credits

Credits to [ElKeoMC](https://modrinth.com/user/ce5e5zW3), who created the optimization modpack included in this modpack!
